description: A point-in-time context package a doper agent assembles for a prompt (or /gm_task session) step, pulled by spawned agents at start. One CURRENT row per (owner, step): prompt-owned rows unique on (prompt_uuid, step), task-owned rows (NULL prompt) unique on (session_uuid, step) — a partial unique index pair. Refs are dot-paths/file-uuids stored as TEXT JSON (point-in-time, deliberately non-normalized); staleness evidence is a server-stamped dope scope revision compared live at read (warn, never block)
name: Agent Briefing

properties.name: Prompt
